name: celld
title_zh: 自家机器上跑 Cloudflare Workers
tagline_zh: Cloudflare 全家桶的 API 你照写，状态却落在自己拥有的 S3/GCS/Azure 桶里——不用改配置…
tagline_en: Write the same Cloudflare Workers APIs, but keep durable state in an S3/GCS/Azure bucket you own. One daemon runs.
desc_en: Working with celld — Deno's self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects daemon that runs a Cloudflare Workers app (Workers, Durable Objects, KV, Queues, D1, R2, Workflows, Cron, static assets) on your own machines from your existing wrangler.json, with durable state in an S3/GCS/Azure bucket you own. Use when writing or deploying a Worker/Durable Object app to celld, running or operating a celld flee
why_zh: 它不模拟 Cloudflare，而是把同一份 wrangler.json 当输入。
why_en: It doesn't emulate Cloudflare; it consumes the same wrangler.json, runs a Deno-based distributed daemon, and persists Durable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 celld 已实现的 Cloudflare 子集，冷门绑定或新 API 可能缺席。
limit_en: Covers only celld's implemented Cloudflare subset; niche bindings or new APIs may be missing. You must supply the state bucket, run Deno locally.
title_en: Run Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects and KV on your own.
